might_form.title: Might Form
might_form.description: Fast and offensive. Higher attack and speed, passive regeneration, Kinetic Energy gained by attacking.

bulwark_form.title: Bulwark Form
bulwark_form.description: Slow and highly defensive. Heavy armor and damage reduction, no regeneration, Kinetic Energy gained by taking damage.

regeneration_upgrade.title: Regeneration
regeneration_upgrade.description: Unlocks passive regeneration in Might Form.

damage_reduction_upgrade.title: Damage Reduction
damage_reduction_upgrade.description: Unlocks the base damage reduction of Bulwark Form.
